- **Option 3 in the body (derive the producer list rather than curating it) is the one that fits the pattern**, and it is also the largest. ⚠️ Whether the ledger's comments are worth a derivation is a real trade — see #9190 / PR #9324 for what deriving a curated list actually cost and bought, and note that its own residue (Q1) is still open with the maintainer.

⛔ No label changed; ⛔ not claimed. Recording the state change so the card stops looking blocked.
